turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Divya, this is Tara from JioHotstar. I'm calling because your JioHotstar Mobile annual plan is set to end on 1 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled. Would you prefer English or Hindi?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, that's exactly what happened. English is fine, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, English it is. So, what made you cancel the AutoPay earlier?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, it's just that I got busy with work and completely forgot to set it up again after my bank reissued the card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ah, that happens! No worries at all. Since you're reactivating before 1 August, you actually get a special 5% loyalty discount on your plan. Would you give it another shot?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Ah, that's a nice perk! Okay, then. I'd be happy to renew for the plan and price you state.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's great to hear! Just open the JioHotstar app, go to your account, and tap 'Renew Subscription'. The 5% discount is already applied there. No link needed, it's all in the app. Shall I wait while you do it, or is there anything else you'd like to know?
